content.title: About
content.content: Toddler pasta is a specially formulated meal for children aged 1 to 3 years. Made from whole‑grain flour, it is enriched with vitamins, minerals, and easily digestible protein. The product has a soft texture and mild flavor, making the transition to solid foods smoother.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The pasta is produced without added salt or sugar to meet pediatric guidelines.
It contains iron, calcium, and vitamin D, essential for bone development in toddlers.
One serving provides about 30 % of the daily requirement for vitamin B12, important for nervous system growth.
Preparation is quick: just add boiling water and let it sit for 3–5 minutes.
The product undergoes strict quality control and complies with infant‑nutrition standards.

items.title: Supports bone growth
items.content: Calcium and vitamin D fortification helps build strong skeletal tissue.

items.title: Boosts immunity
items.content: B‑vitamins and vitamin C contribute to the body’s defense mechanisms.

items.title: Easy‑to‑digest protein
items.content: Plant‑based protein is readily absorbed and aids muscle development.

items.title: Iron content
items.content: Iron helps prevent anemia during rapid growth periods.

items.title: Promotes healthy digestion
items.content: Dietary fiber supports regular bowel movements and reduces constipation.

items.title: Grain allergy
items.content: Some children may be allergic to wheat or other grains used in the product.

items.title: Over‑consumption
items.content: Because of its energy density, portion sizes should be monitored to avoid excess weight gain.

items.title: Choking hazard
items.content: Although soft, the pasta should be served in small, manageable pieces under adult supervision.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Pour boiling water (about 150 ml) over the pasta and let it sit for 3–5 minutes. Then mix with vegetable puree, cottage cheese, or a small amount of meat sauce. For variety, add finely chopped steamed vegetables.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the unopened package in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep the contents in an airtight container and use within 30 days.
